summary: Routes design and default-off implementation boundaries: authenticated route discovery, distinct app and approval publication, temporary native HTTPS admission and untrusted Nearby hints. Current discovery and native ranking statements reconciled with their callers; later relay consolidation remains proposed.
limits: Change-scoped source and fixture review, not installed-shell, signed-installer or physical-device qualification. Public identity and relayable nonce proofs alone do not authorize alternate credential origins. Canonical profile ownership, TLS validation and existing access permissions remain required.
